name: Glass
notes: Window glass, bottles, lanterns, jars. Non-flammable. Density 2500 kg/m³ (soda-lime glass). Very fragile: 5 J (a thrown stone or a dropped bottle) breaks it. Transparent. Walking on glass (shards) is the loudest surface (+12 dB, audio bible §7.3: glass-shards are very loud). Hard surface: arrows ricochet (or shatter it via fragile). (mw-e03.31)
